verdict.rationale: RUN's own docs say you can "pay employees and contractors" from the same payroll product. They also say ADP will create, deliver and e-file both W-2 and 1099 forms (for an additional fee), and that workers can view their W-2s/1099s in one place. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the contractor payment workflow (e.g., contractor direct deposit and onboarding), independent or hands-on corroboration, and year-end 1099 filing included in the base price rather than at an extra fee.
